observed_contract: minRingSize defaults to 1024, maxRingSize defaults to 4096, both validate in [1, 8388608], and min cannot exceed max
the default independent channel ring cap is 4096
virtual nodes hash endpoint key plus underscore plus ordinal with seed-zero XXH64 and use sorted lower-bound lookup with wraparound
duplicate endpoints combine weight and keep one connection-owning child
an explicit request hash sticks to the selected endpoint while it connects and walks clockwise only after failure
requestHashHeader hashes the final metadata value and uses a random hash when the header is absent
one logical endpoint may own several physical addresses through an inner pick-first policy

implementation.module: channel/ring_hash.zig owns allocation-bounded weighted ketama construction, lookup, unique endpoint walks, request-hash resolution, endpoint identity, and XXH64 helpers
implementation.configuration: service config validates canonical integer or integer-string ring sizes and lowercase non-reserved ASCII requestHashHeader names
implementation.endpoint_policy: every endpoint supports an optional stable ring_hash_key and positive ring_hash_weight; duplicate identities merge weight without creating another owner
implementation.ordinary_channel: the selected endpoint is connected serially before clockwise failure fallback; unrelated Happy Eyeballs races cannot override an explicit hash; the configured header is deep-owned beyond ServiceConfig lifetime
implementation.shared_channel: the ring indexes logical resolver sources, while source-local physical workers preserve multi-address pick-first ownership; membership promotion invalidates and transactionally rebuilds the ring
implementation.ownership: queued SharedChannel jobs retain their resolved hash, unary and streaming inputs clone the scalar attribute, and header-missing random fallback is chosen once per submitted physical attempt
implementation.resource_bound: runtime ring entries are capped at 4096 even when an untrusted service config supplies the protocol maximum
